# gitops

OpenShift GitOps operator and the platform ArgoCD instance

Stability: stable ([Compatibility](https://policystk.io/reference/compatibility/#element-stability))

```yaml
stack:
  gitops:
    enabled: true
```

## Settings

Under `stack.gitops.config`. Maps merge across layers; lists are replaced whole.

| Key | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `namespace` | Namespace the platform ArgoCD instance runs in | `openshift-gitops` |
| `disableAdmin` | Disable the built-in admin account and rely on OpenShift OAuth | `false` |
| `monitoring` | Expose ArgoCD metrics to the monitoring stack | `false` |
| `kustomizeBuildOptions` | Kustomize flags. Enables Helm. PolicyStack does not use the PolicyGenerator plugin. | `--enable-helm --helm-command /usr/local/bin/helm` |
| `rbacPolicies` | ArgoCD RBAC, one CSV line per entry | 2 entries, below |
| `ha` |  |  |
| `ha.enabled` | Run Redis in HA mode. Needs at least three nodes. | `false` |
| `serverAutoscale` |  |  |
| `serverAutoscale.enabled` |  | `false` |
| `serverAutoscale.maxReplicas` |  | `10` |
| `serverAutoscale.targetCPUUtilizationPercentage` |  | `50` |
| `resources` | Per-component resource requests and limits | 7 entries, below |

## Operators

Each renders into Policy `install` with `<name>-ns` and `<name>-status`. Pin with `operatorPolicies.<key>.versions` in a layer.

| Operator policy | Package | Channel | Source | Namespace | Versions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `install-gitops` | `openshift-gitops-operator` | `latest` | `redhat-operators` | `openshift-gitops-operator` | any |

## Policies

`<cluster>` is the ManagedCluster name, or hubName on the hub. `global.remediationAction: inform` overrides every action below.

Standards: NIST SP 800-53. Controls: CM-2 Baseline Configuration. Categories: CM Configuration Management.

### Policy `install`

`install-gitops-<cluster>`: Install and manage the OpenShift GitOps operator.

| Template | Action | Severity | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `install-gitops` | enforce | medium | [operator](#operators) `openshift-gitops-operator` | OpenShift GitOps operator |

### Policy `instance`

`instance-gitops-<cluster>`: Platform ArgoCD instance. Depends on `install-gitops-<cluster>`.

| Template | Action | Severity | Waits for | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `instance-argocd` | enforce | medium | `install-gitops-status`<br>compliant while pending | [argocd](converters/instance/argocd.yaml) | ArgoCD instance |
| `instance-ca-bundle` | enforce | medium |  | [ca-bundle](converters/instance/ca-bundle.yaml) | Trusted CA bundle for ArgoCD |

### Policy `link`

`link-gitops-<cluster>`: Console link to ArgoCD. Depends on `instance-gitops-<cluster>`.

| Template | Action | Severity | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `link-argocd-console` | enforce | low | [argocd-console](converters/link/argocd-console.yaml) | ArgoCD console link |
